interpretation: Primary acts and decisions below establish particular changes. No assertion that every later amendment or judicial disposition has been cleared. No numerical FY2028 tariff assumption is authorized by this ledger.

authorities.status_established: Supreme Court held IEEPA does not authorize tariffs on 2026-02-20. Same-day executive order ended the enumerated IEEPA duties while preserving other authorities.
anchors: Learning Resources, Inc. v. Trump, 24-1287, syllabus and holding

authorities.status_established: CIT 26-123 (2026-10-08) certifies the non-plaintiff importer class. Its account reports approximately 126bn duties plus interest refunded through October2; certification does not itself establish a final schedule for remaining cash payments. BEA accrues the one-time refund capital transfer in 2026Q1, separately from current customs and interest.

February20 proclamation imposes10% from February24 with endpoint July24,2026 unless Congress extends. That instrument alone provides no FY2028 authority. A complete audit of intervening legislation and Section122 litigation was not completed.

Separate authority preserved by February20 order. April2 metals proclamation modified in June1 proclamation; some temporary equipment rates change on January1,2028. July20 aluminum proclamation adds a separate mechanism. These reviewed metals sources do not cover the complete autos, pharmaceuticals, lumber, semiconductors, drones, or other schedules and subsequent litigation.

July23 USTR final notice imposed forced-labor tariffs on60 economies from July24,10% or12.5% with exemptions, MFN ceiling rules, and phase-in provisions. CIT official court record lists September30 oral argument in In Re Section301 Forced Labor Cases,26-03555. No final disposition or complete subsequent-amendment clearance is certified. Earlier China and separate Brazil schedules also require separate reconstruction.
anchors: USTR final notice pages1-2 and12-14 plus annexes

authorities.status_established: July20 Canadian motor-vehicle, alcohol, and dairy proclamations imposed50% duties subject to product annexes. September8 proclamations published September14 changed motor-vehicle/alcohol scope and added import exclusions for products linked to all three disputes. Latest applicable product scope, import prohibitions, stacking and subsequent litigation need explicit reconstruction, rather than July-only rates.

business_law.bonus_depreciation: IRS Publication946 confirms100% for qualifying property acquired and placed in service after January19,2025; JCT section70301 FY2028 score is not the same comparison as60% frozen2024 bonus rules.
business_law.domestic_research: IRS Revenue Procedure2025-28, published in IRB2025-38, section2.04 confirms section174A domestic R&E deduction for amounts paid or incurred in tax years beginning after December31,2024, with elections and transitional rules.
